Q6_structures_vs_corpus.claim: our 465 enumerated structures match an independently curated source for the same library
Q6_structures_vs_corpus.what_the_disagreements_are: SC3 (15 lipids): Figure 1b draws an UNBRANCHED 3-segment chain and the trace finds 0 branch nodes, i.e. n-propyl; the corpus's IL_SMILES has neopentyl. 3A2 (31): Figure 1b draws a PIPERAZINE (the molecule has 3 N) and the corpus structure has 2 N, a piperidine -- the formulae differ, C51H93N3O12S3 vs C52H94N2O12S3. 5A2 and 6A1 (62): identical formula, different placement of the free N-H on tetraethylenepentamine, which is the partial-substitution convention this curation flags as positional_ambiguity on every affected row. All four are queued in DECISIONS.md; none is resolved here.
Q6_structures_vs_corpus.two_of_our_own_errors_this_check_caught: SO2 and SO8 were first transcribed one carbon short, and the whole arm was first built as a DISULFIDE because the arm fragment carried a plausible but wrong attachment atom. Nothing in the assembly complained: every structure parsed, no radicals, stereo preserved. Only the corpus comparison saw it.

seeded.metric: full-InChIKey agreements with corpus KZ_2016, out of 465
seeded.read: the InChIKey separates them and the FORMULA DOES NOT. Any HRMS or composition check is blind to this, which is why the regiochemistry is taken from Scheme 1's written two-step synthesis and not from a mass.

Q8_nmr_hydrogen_count.claim: the SI prints a 1H NMR peak list with integrals for every in-vivo lipid; the integrals must sum to the structure's hydrogen count
Q8_nmr_hydrogen_count.why_it_is_worth_having: it is SYMBOLIC and tier-4 -- printed numerals in the PDF's text layer, nothing digitised -- and it is sensitive to a one-carbon error anywhere in the molecule, which no colour or bar check is.
Q8_nmr_hydrogen_count.how_to_read_the_discrepancies: this check is REPORTED, not gated. A peak list whose multiplet count is below the median is a block our regex truncated at a page boundary, not a wrong structure; the remainder differ by a few protons, which is what rounding an overlapping multiplet does. The useful signal is that 19 of 25 sum EXACTLY, including 3A4-SC5 at 86 = 86, and that no discrepancy is near the 12-14 H a one-carbon-per-arm error would cause.
